# XMEL Automations

> AI automation agency building autonomous voice AI agents, n8n workflow automations, and intelligent lead response systems for businesses across real estate and home services.

XMEL Automations designs, builds, and deploys AI-powered systems that eliminate manual bottlenecks in lead response, customer communication, and operational workflows. We use GPT-4o-mini, Twilio, Vapi, ElevenLabs, and n8n to create autonomous systems that respond instantly, 24/7.

Founded by Yashwardhan Chauhan, based in India, working with clients globally.

## Services

- [AI Automation for Real Estate Agents](https://xmelautomations.xyz/ai-automation-real-estate): AI inside sales agents that respond to real estate leads in under 50 seconds — qualifying, booking, and syncing to CRM.
- [AI Automation for Home Services](https://xmelautomations.xyz/ai-automation-home-services): AI receptionists and lead response systems for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors that stop missed calls from costing jobs.
- [AI Lead Response Automation](https://xmelautomations.xyz/#isa-system): Autonomous systems that qualify, respond to, and book appointments with inbound leads across voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and web forms.
- [Voice AI Agent Development](https://xmelautomations.xyz/#isa-system): Custom AI phone agents built on Vapi, Twilio, and ElevenLabs that answer calls, qualify prospects, and book appointments 24/7.
- [n8n Workflow Automation](https://xmelautomations.xyz/#isa-system): Complex multi-step automations connecting CRM, lead qualification, appointment booking, notifications, and data sync.
- [WhatsApp Automation Bot](https://xmelautomations.xyz/#isa-system): AI-powered WhatsApp chatbots that qualify leads, answer questions, and sync data to CRM in real time.

## Case Studies

- [AI ISA System — PropertyPulse Realty](https://xmelautomations.xyz/#work): Fully autonomous inside sales agent for a Mumbai brokerage. 67-node n8n workflow handling inbound leads from MagicBricks and 99acres — qualify, call, book, sync. Lead response under 50 seconds.
- [Voice AI Receptionist — HomeServe India](https://xmelautomations.xyz/#work): AI voice receptionist for a Bengaluru plumbing and HVAC company. Every call answered via Vapi and Twilio, every job qualified, every slot booked into Google Calendar. 43% more bookings in pilot.

- Specializes in AI automation for real estate and home services

- 67-node n8n workflows with 7 webhook triggers
